title: A computed bounded-below square has the expected derived mate factorization
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal A',\mathcal B'$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and bounded-below subcategories [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], in arbitrary compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose $\mathcal A,\mathcal A'$ have enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Give additive adjunctions $L:\mathcal B\rightleftarrows\mathcal A:R$ and $L':\mathcal B'\rightleftarrows\mathcal A':R'$ with $L,L'$ exact, and exact additive functors $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B'$ and $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A'$. Write $K(F)$ for termwise application on bounded-below homotopy categories, $q$ for homotopy localization, $D(F)$ for exact descent, and $\phi_{F,N}:D(F)(qN)\xrightarrow{\sim}qK(F)N$ for the exact-functor comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Use the canonical derived adjunctions [lem-trf-bounded-below-derived-adjunction] $D(L)\dashv U=\mathbf R R$ and $D(L')\dashv U'=\mathbf R R'$, with comparison units $\alpha_P:qK(R)P\to U(qP)$ and $\alpha'_{P'}:qK(R')P'\to U'(qP')$ [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective]. Let $\sigma:L'G\to HL$ be arbitrary, let $b:GR\to R'H$ be its ordinary mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], and give a derived square $\theta:D(L')D(G)\to D(H)D(L)$. For every $N\in K^+(\mathcal B)$ put $A_N=\phi_{L',K(G)N}\circ D(L')(\phi_{G,N})$ and $B_N=\phi_{H,K(L)N}\circ D(H)(\phi_{L,N})$. Assume
$$B_N\circ\theta_{qN}=q(\sigma^K_N)\circ A_N,$$
where $\sigma^K$ is the termwise transformation, with the canonical termwise composition identifications. If $m:D(G)U\to U'D(H)$ is the mate of $\theta$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], then for every $P\in K^+(\mathcal A)$,
$$m_{qP}\circ D(G)(\alpha_P)=U'(\phi_{H,P}^{-1})\circ\alpha'_{K(H)P}\circ q(K(b)_P)\circ\phi_{G,K(R)P}.$$
Neither $\sigma$ nor either comparison unit is assumed invertible, and $H$ need not preserve injectives.

proof.text: Expand mateEquiv into the primed derived unit, image of θ, and image of the unprimed derived counit. Naturality of the unit and θ moves D⁺(G)(α_P) next to the counit. The counit comparison of [lem-trf-bounded-below-derived-adjunction] replaces that pair by q of the termwise counit and the exact L comparison. Naturality of the H comparison and the assumed hθ then replace the inside composite by q of σ followed by H of this counit.

The primed unit comparison of [lem-trf-bounded-below-derived-adjunction] and naturality of the right-derived comparison unit [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective] replace the remaining transpose by q of the termwise mate followed by the primed comparison unit. The termwise identity is [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy]. Functoriality and associativity give exactly the equation, retaining the G comparison and inverse H comparison at the two ends. This is the complete existing Lean proof in the cited source, valid also for σ = 0, identity squares, noninvertible σ, and zero categories.

theorem derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac (adj : L ⊣ R) (adj' : L' ⊣ R')
    (σ : TwoSquare G L L' G')
    (θ : TwoSquare G.mapDerivedCategoryPlus L.mapDerivedCategoryPlus L'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus
      G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus)
    (hθ : ∀ N : HomotopyCategory.Plus C₂,
      θ.natTrans.app (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj N) ≫
          G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (L.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.hom.app N) ≫
          G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.hom.app (L.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj N) =
        L'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (G.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.hom.app N) ≫
          L'.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.hom.app (G.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj N) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus σ.natTrans).app N))
    (K : HomotopyCategory.Plus C₁) :
    G.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app K) ≫
        (mateEquiv adj.derivedPlus adj'.derivedPlus θ).natTrans.app
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj K) =
      G.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.hom.app (R.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus (mateEquiv adj adj' σ).natTrans).app K) ≫
        R'.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app (G'.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
        R'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.inv.app K)
